query:
SELECT ls.twitch_user_id, ls.streamer_login,
                ls.active_session_id AS "active_session_id!",
                COALESCE(ps.is_partner_active, 0) AS "is_partner_active!" FROM twitch_live_state ls LEFT JOIN twitch_streamers_partner_state ps ON LOWER(ps.twitch_login) = LOWER(ls.streamer_login) WHERE ls.is_live = 1 AND ls.active_session_id IS NOT NULL AND ls.last_seen_at::timestamptz > now() - interval '15 minutes'
